title: Bratwurst and Cheddar Breakfast Casserole
description: This Bratwurst and Cheddar Breakfast Casserole made with sausage, eggs, cheese, and veggies is a hearty choice for your Sunday morning breakfast or holiday brunch.
ingredients: 2 cup sharp white cheddar or other cheese, shredded
3 cups thick sliced bread, cut into 1-inch cubes, lightly toasted
directions: Preheat your oven to 350 degrees F.
Grease a 9 x 13 baking dish with olive oil spray.
In a large bowl, beat the eggs, then mix in the milk, shredded cheese, and dry mustard. Add the bread cubes and gently stir them into the egg mixture.
In a large skillet, brown the sausage in olive oil over medium-high heat for three minutes, turning over once. Remove to cutting board.
Add the onions to the skillet and season with salt and pepper. Cook for about 3 minutes, stirring occasionally. Add the cut up tomatoes.
Slice the sausages into little rounds, on the bias.
Stir the sausage, onion/tomato mixture, and cheese into the egg mixture. Pour into the prepared baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 50 minutes. Let sit for 10 minutes before serving.
